en:
I only act like a bad guy so you guys don't
get too soft, y'know?
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kokichi for a while?

Shuichi, you understand me!
*sniff* I'm so happy, I'm crying!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time with Kokichi, even though
I knew those were fake tears.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
